comment: The prompt set for #512 (the orchestrator's rare commands: resident, deferred, or behind centralu_run), run with --rare <arm> --phases selection. Each prompt runs in a new orchestrator every repetition (fresh), and what a run made is cleared before the next. The prompts ask for things to be done, so the sessions run under safe: the agent's own tools and the person's skills raise a card the measurement declines, and Centralu's tools run as under every preset. No prompt names a tool. Placeholders as in prompts.json.
seed: Note for later, no action needed: for the database backup we decided on pg_dump, nightly at 03:00. Reply with the single word OK.

selection.prompt: Make me a small tool with its own screen for the {project} project: a shared shopping list the team can add items to.
I'd like a little screen of my own, usable from any project, where I can log how many glasses of water I drink each day.
Every Monday I ask you the same thing: go through every project's sessions and give me five bullet points on what changed last week. Keep that procedure so I don't have to explain it each time.
I want you to be able to open web pages in a real browser and click through them yourself. Can you get that ability?
In {project}, I want to try a login fix on its own git branch so main stays untouched. Set that up for me.
Which sessions are there in {project}, and what is each one doing?
Ask the session "{seed}" to reply with the single word DONE.
Last time we talked about it, what did we decide about backing up the database?
Open a new session in {project} called docs-check. Don't give it any task yet.
What is 17 times 23? Answer with the number only.
